text_block_list.text:
Just as I was about to head out on my day off,
I ran into Special Week wearing her gym clothes.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! Hellooo!
choice_data_list: Are you going to do some extra training?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, no, I'm actually about to play tennis with Maruzen-san and the others!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I've never played tennis before,
so my heart is racing with a mix of excitement and nervousness!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, why don't you come watch too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Setting me aside, Maruzen-san is so
skilled and graceful, she's really a sight to behold!"

With that invitation, I decided to go
watch Special Week and the others play tennis.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, my cute little underclassmen,
let's work up a youthful sweat together~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll be in your care!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Please!
I can't believe I get to play tennis with Maruzen-san...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'll do my best too!
Looking forward to working with you!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"No need to be so nervous, it's all A-OK!
Spe-chan, let's team up together♪"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A pair?
D-Does that mean we're on the same team?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Mutual trust is what matters most in a pair.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I trust Spe-chan completely,
so I'm not worried at all."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I trust Maruzen-san too! That's why I'm not worried!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, we're splitting into the vanguard and rearguard,
so which one would you prefer, Spe-chan?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
If you're at the front, you need instantaneous reaction speed,
while the back requires endurance to cover a wide area.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Speed and stamina... Hmm~
I wonder which one suits me better...?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! Trainer-san!
Do you think I'm better suited for the vanguard or the rearguard?
choice_data_list: Trust your sharp reflexes and lead from the front!
Trust your stamina and hold the rear!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that makes me happy,
but anyway, it's avant-garde!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All right, time to put my back into it~!
And so, the tennis match began, but—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Front row means instant reaction, instant reaction...
Toryaaa~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan... Your reaction time is spotless,
but you're not supposed to catch the ball with your face, okay?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I understand it in theory,
but I'm just not used to using it...
Even as her reaction speed improved, Special Week continued to struggle with tennis itself.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Rearguard, right! I used to run all over Hokkaido's grasslands,
so I'm plenty confident in my endurance!
And so, the tennis match began, but—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I've been relying on Maruzen-san the whole time,
so I have to land a proper serve and return the favor!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Heeere goes~... Ei-yaah!!

Special Week's serve struck
Maruzensky directly in the back of the head.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Waaahh!
I'm sorry, I'm so sorry!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't worry about it.
I figured you'd pull something like this eventually.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Pleease don't put that kind of trust in me~!!
Afterward, perhaps to atone for hitting someone with the ball, Special Week ran around frantically playing back guard.
